notes.title: [DEV Log] Update Rumbly Progress!!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the Rumbly Demo!!
We’re thrilled to see your reactions, feedback, and support.



Rumbly is still in active development — what you're playing now is just a glimpse of what’s to come!
We're working hard to improve everything from combat mechanics to UI, character content, progression systems, and more.

If you enjoyed the demo or want to see how the game evolves,
be sure to Wishlist Rumbly and follow us to stay updated with every major step forward!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/401736815fec510cc9d29e8ed01be4707a31961a.png"]
Here's a sneak peek at some new enemies and bosses!
We're cooking up brand-new challenges to test your reflexes and strategy.
Each enemy brings unique patterns, timing twists, and surprises — get ready to rethink your moves!

Stay tuned for more updates!!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/9d5a30d7720d6ea8c45c2b4c6c6c6a2645ea1116.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560988/127aaa17c0b11c3ffe233c0f59f5b5dc1604e4ed.gif"]

notes.title: Rumbly - Update 0.1.9 is live!
notes.notes:
Update 0.1.9

We’ve made major HP adjustments to many enemies across the game!
Now you can blast through battles faster and enjoy a smoother, more thrilling run.

Try the new balance and let us know what you think!
Demo available now on Steam!
